title: dryopteris rigida var. arguta
intro: Dryopteris rigida var. arguta, commonly known as the alpine wood fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of alpine wood fern include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system regulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
